archetypes.name: dyn-runlog-hook
archetypes.rationale: Run-log commit retry must not re-copy or re-scrub and must preserve hook failure semantics.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the run-log commit changes around the extracted commit tail and retry behavior. Focus on whether copy, scrub, volatile-only cleanup, and breadcrumb publish remain outside the retry loop, and whether second-attempt failures return actionable but not overbroad hook remedies. Check unchanged and volatile-only envelopes for compatibility. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
